linear_form_wick.statement: Let y be uniform on Max+={y∈{±1}^n: C y = p y} for a conference matrix C of order n=p²+1. Then E[y_i y_j]=δ_ij + C_ij/p =: Σ_ij (tight frame / Prop Max+ E[yy^T]=I+C/p). For any α∈R^n, L=∑ α_i y_i satisfies E[L²]=∑_{i,j} α_i α_j Σ_ij = E_{G~N(0,Σ)}[L(G)²].
linear_form_wick.corollary_U1: U1=∑_{r∈R1} C_ar y_r is linear, so E[U1²]=E_Wick[U1²] exactly.
linear_form_wick.method: Expand E[L²] using only pairwise moments; no fourth moments used.

gd_formulation.Z: Z = star_a · ∏_{u∈S\{a}} y_u  (degree-3, E[Z]=0 by central symmetry)
gd_formulation.identity: star_a · S1(a) = E[Z U1] − E_Wick[Z U1] = Cov(Z,U1) − Cov_Wick(Z,U1)
gd_formulation.specialization: GD fails for generic linear forms L (≈50% violation rate at p=5) and is therefore special to the κ1-support of U1, not a general cubic×linear comparison.
gd_formulation.U_ext_note: For U_ext=∑_{r∉S} C_ar y_r one has E[Z U_ext]=star·p·ρ, E_Wick=2/p²; GD for U_ext ⇔ star·p·ρ ≤ 2/p² ⇔ joint S1+S3 ≤ 0, which fails at some p=7 maximisers (joint>0). U1 is strictly harder.

sum_star_tau1.formula: sum_{|κ|=1} star·τ1 = ε(p) · n1 with n1=n(n-1)(n-2)²/32, ε∈{±1}
sum_star_tau1.epsilon_open: ε(p)=+1 at p=5, ε(p)=−1 at p=3,7 (and mean −1 at p=11). Closed form for ε(p) open; not needed for pointwise GD.
sum_star_tau1.p7_equipartition: At p=7 the three values −7,−1,5 each occur on exactly n1/3 sets.

cand_path.path: GD (star·S1≤0) + star=+1 ⇒ pρ ≤ 2/p² + S3. Still need S3 bound (or joint) for ρ≤ρ_cand when S3_budget<0.
